data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 邪龙黑旗·烈焰废墟上的傲慢冷笑
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 烈焰废墟·邪龙黑旗与傲慢冷笑】燃烧着无尽红莲业火的焦黑废墟之上，身披黑铁铠甲的复仇者高高立起漆黑的邪龙军旗。黑贞反手握着被火光灼热的诅咒之剑，嘴角勾起傲慢而狂暴的冷笑——「哈哈哈哈！愚蠢的杂碎们，在龙之魔女的业火中化作灰烬吧！御主，好好看着我为你烧尽一切阻碍的姿态！」
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter stands among the burning ruins with one armored hand steadying the dragon banner already planted in the broken stones. Her other hand holds the cursed sword low at her side in a reversed grip. The dark cape lifts behind her spiked armor as she looks across the firelit space with a fierce, confident smile. Crimson flames illuminate the flag edge, short silver hair and golden eyes, while the ground beneath her boots remains clear. A low vertical view includes both hands, the banner base and complete sword. No lettering.
data.location: 法兰西百年战争燃烧废墟
data.action: 一手稳住已插入碎石地面的邪龙旗，另一手反握诅咒之剑低垂在身侧
data.lighting: 冲天烈火与飞扬火星构筑的剧烈火光，将黑铠与苍白面庞映照得极具戏剧张力
data.camera: full-body low-angle shot, planted banner and lowered sword visible
